verdict.rationale: SigNoz can be self-hosted in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, keeping "full control of your data plane" (signoz-gh-1). That lets you place data wherever you choose, but only by running the stack yourself, and community users describe that self-hosted stack as heavy, with many containers to configure (signoz-comm-1, signoz-comm-4). Missing for 10: documented region or residency selection for SigNoz Cloud, data-residency or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
